answer_1.quote: We first assess how DiVA compares to baseline models for various spoken language benchmarks ... We evaluate benchmarks for spoken question answering, speech classification, and speech translation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses to spoken inputs (answers, translations, classifications)

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU scores across 7 CoVoST2 languages ... Accuracy is assessed using the PEDANTS metric ... Classification performance is reported with F1 scores.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 53 participants on the Prolific platform to provide preference ratings ... Users were shown responses from each model ... 72% Win Rate ...
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to compare response pairs from two models and indicate which they preferred.
